_readme: Hand-maintained companion to scripts/crd-keys.json, which is GENERATED and must
never be edited by hand. scripts/gen_crd_keys.py never touches this file.
foreignVocabularies waives a key that belongs to a schema tatara does not own, so
there is no tatara CRD or chart for it to appear in. Every entry MUST carry a
non-empty reason naming that schema; check_crd_keys.py exits 2 on an empty or
non-string reason rather than skipping the check. A waiver added to turn a red
build green, with no reason attached, is how this guard stops checking
This is the WRONG place for a tatara key that was removed. A page that
deliberately names a retired field takes a per-line `<!-- crd-ok: name -->`
marker instead, so the site stays visible in the page rather than being blessed

foreignVocabularies.backoffLimit: batch/v1 Job.spec. The ingester page shows the Job the operator builds, not a chart value.
foreignVocabularies.initContainers: core/v1 PodSpec. Rendered pod manifests on component pages show it; AgentSpec's own knob is the distinct `extraInitContainers`.
foreignVocabularies.serviceAccountName: core/v1 PodSpec, in a rendered manifest.
foreignVocabularies.stringData: core/v1 Secret. Every `kubectl apply` example that mints a tatara Secret uses it.
foreignVocabularies.webhookSecret: A DATA KEY inside the tatara-managed `<project>-scm` Secret, not a chart value or a CRD field. The chart value that populates it is `scmWebhookSecret`; see tatara-operator api/v1alpha1/project_types.go for the key set the operator reads out of that Secret.
